lines.text: Naomi hears that the LORD has provided food for His people, so she sets out with her daughters-in-law on the road back to the land of Edom, and out on that road she tells them to go back to their mothers' homes.

problems.problem: It gives away line 2's true detail "Ruth".
Its true detail "Orpah kisses her mother-in-law goodbye, but Ruth clings to her" isn't in Ruth 1:14 word for word.
Its wrong detail "Ruth kisses her goodbye" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
Its true detail "Orpah kisses her mother-in-law goodbye, but Ruth clings to her" isn't in the Prep cards, so the walkthrough didn't teach it.
